title: Koi Suru Tenshi Angelique: Kagayaki no Ashita

date-tvdb.reason: The failing special is AniDB S1 'When Love Awakens / Ai ga Mezameru Toki' (mirror 2007-08-24), placed by default on TVDB S0E1 'Kagayaki No Ashita OVA' (TVDB date 2007-04-08). It is that OVA: the DVD-only 'Kagayaki no Ashita Special' (MAL 7333; aniSearch lists it as 'Kagayaki no Ashita - Ai ga Mezameru Toki'). Same programme by title; the dates differ because AniDB dates the DVD release and TVDB the first announcement/issue. S2 'Chibi Chara Adventure' and S3 'Angel World Illustrated Book 1' land on S0E2/S0E3, which do not exist (not an error). The 12 regular episodes match TVDB S2 by title and order (A New Mission ... Toward a Shining Tomorrow). Once 4197 unmaps its S1, this node is the only claimant of S0E1.
